items.title: 18.4 Zarrat ki lehar wali fitrat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the wave nature of particles (PDF 125-127).

blocks.text: Roshni dohri fitrat dikhati hai: lehar ki tarah bhi aur zarre ki tarah bhi. Qudrat mein mutanasib-pan farz karte hue French physicist Louis de Broglie ne 1924 mein tajweez kiya ke zarrat mein bhi lehar jaisi khasiyatein honi chahiye. Photon ka momentum p = h/lambda (18.3) hai; de Broglie ne tajweez kiya ke v velocity se chalte m kamiyat ke maddi zarre ka momentum bhi isi formula se milta hai: p = h/lambda = mv, ya lambda = h/p = h/(mv) (18.10), jahan lambda zarre ki lehar ki wavelength hai. Yeh de Broglie talluq hai: electron ko zarra aur lehar dono samjha ja sakta hai.

Bari kamiyat aur aam raftar wali cheez ki wavelength itni chhoti hoti hai ke us ke lehar wale asraat, jaise interference aur diffraction, na-qabil-e-zikr hain. 330 m s^-1 se urti 20 g ki bandooq ki goli ka lambda = h/(mv) = 6.63 x 10^-34 / (2 x 10^-2 x 330) = 1 x 10^-34 m, napne ke liye bohat chhota. Lekin 1 x 10^6 m s^-1 se chalte electron ka lambda = 6.63 x 10^-34 / (9.1 x 10^-31 x 1 x 10^6) = 7 x 10^-10 m, X-ray ki had mein. Is liye electrons ke diffraction asraat nape ja sakte hain, jab ke goliyon ke interference asraat nahi.

Electrons ki lehar wali fitrat ka qaail karne wala saboot Clinton J. Davisson aur Lester H. Germer ne diya, jinhon ne dikhaya ke electrons dhaat ke crystals se bilkul X-rays ki tarah diffract hote hain. Un ke saaman (Fig 18.7) mein garam filament se electrons badalne wale voltage se tez kiye jate aur shua nickel crystal par dali jati hai. Bikhre electrons ba-qaida chotiyon (peaks) mein nikle, jinhein unhon ne crystal se X-ray diffraction ki tarah diffraction samjha. Electron lehron ki wavelength bilkul wahi thi jo de Broglie ne predict ki thi.

blocks.alt: Garam filament wali electron gun apni shua neeche nickel crystal par dalti hai. Crystal se dashed lakeer mure scale par sarakne wale detector tak jati hai; aane wali aur bikhri shua ke darmiyan zaviya phi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.7: electron diffraction ke liye Davisson aur Germer ka tajurbati intizam (kitab ki Figure 18.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Detector ko scale par ghuma kar har zaviye phi par bikhre electrons ka current napa jata hai. Kuch khaas zaviyon par current ki chotiyan (peaks) milti hain, bilkul X-rays ke diffraction ki tarah; yeh electrons ki lehar wali fitrat ka saboot hai.

V potential se tez kiye gaye electron ki K.E. ka izafa (1/2) mv^2 = Ve hai, is liye mv^2 = 2Ve, m^2 v^2 = 2mVe aur mv = (2mVe) ka square root. De Broglie ki equation se lambda = h/(mv), is liye lambda = h / (2mVe) ka square root (18.11). Aik tajurbe mein V 54 volt tha: lambda = 6.63 x 10^-34 / (2 x 9.1 x 10^-31 x 54 x 1.6 x 10^-19) ka square root = 1.66 x 10^-10 m. Diffracted shua 65 darje ke glancing zawiye par mili, aur Bragg ki equation 2d sin(theta) = m lambda, m = 1 aur nickel ke liye d = 0.91 x 10^-10 m ke saath, lambda = 2 x 0.91 x 10^-10 x sin 65 darje = 1.65 x 10^-10 m deti hai: peshgoi se behtareen mutabiqat.

Protons, neutrons, hydrogen atoms aur helium atoms ke saath bhi diffraction naqshe dekhe gaye hain, jo zarrat ki lehar wali fitrat ka mazboot saboot hain. De Broglie ko 1929 ka Physics Nobel Prize mila; Clinton Davisson aur George Paget Thomson ne zarrat ki lehar wali fitrat ki tajurbati tasdeeq par 1937 ka Nobel Prize baanta.

blocks.prompt: 100 V se tez kiye gaye electron ki de Broglie wavelength maloom karein.

items: de Broglie: lambda = h/p = h/(mv); tez kiye electron ke liye lambda = h/sqrt(2meV).
Goliyan: wavelength bohat chhoti; electrons: qabil-e-paimaish (X-ray had).
Davisson-Germer: nickel se electron diffraction ne tasdeeq ki.
